items.title: Solana sees record 263K tokens issued in a single day
items.whyYouShouldCare: The issuance of 263K tokens in a single day highlights Solana's growing ecosystem and potential for increased liquidity and user engagement.

items.title: Robinhood’s crypto volume increases 61% in August, still down 38% YoY
items.whyYouShouldCare: Robinhood's 61% increase in crypto volume indicates rising interest, which could positively impact Solana's market positioning and app integrations.

items.title: Your Bitcoin trade can now get liquidated because a stock crashed
items.whyYouShouldCare: The new liquidation risk for Bitcoin trades due to stock crashes underscores the interconnectedness of markets, affecting investor sentiment towards Solana's stability.
